entities.summary: Vasily Vasilyevich Vakhrushev was a Soviet and Russian politician who was from 1939 to 1940 the Chairman of the Council of People's Commissars of the Russian SFSR, equivalent to Prime Minister. He was also the People's Commissar for Coal Industry from 1939 to 1946. His ashes were buried at the Kremlin Wall Necropolis.
